name: VQ-HEVC Hybrid Compression for SH-AC
definition: A compression method that replaces the direct HEVC coding of SH-AC coefficients with a VQ-based representation (indices) while keeping other attributes in the GSC anchor pipeline, targeting the low spatial correlation of SH-AC maps.
summary: VQ-HEVC Hybrid Compression replaces direct HEVC coding of Spherical Harmonics coefficients with a two-stage vector quantization process that packs indices into 2D maps for lossless HEVC compression.
